topics.title: The learning method: trace, don't memorize

tokens.v: When a field defaults to a value you didn't expect, the trainer's advice was to trace it back to where it actually comes from — the item master, business-partner data, order type, sales user profile — using the session's own
control, rather than guessing or memorizing "it's always X." No single default source was actually pinned down in this session; these were framed as questions to go investigate, not answers.
